    Method to convert trip objects to move2 objects

    mt_as_move2.trip.Rd

    Convert trip objects to move2 objects.

    # S3 method for class 'trip'
mt_as_move2(x, ...)

    Arguments

    x

    A trip object

    ...

    Additional arguments (currently ignored)

    Value

    A move2 object

    Examples

    mt_as_move2(trip::walrus818)
